diario_da_republica.how_to: The Diário da República eletrónico (INCM) offers free universal access with search of acts in the 1.ª and 2.ª séries (Decreto-Lei 83/2016). In the 2.ª série each act names its issuing entity, so a reader searches the 2.ª série by entity name (for example Município de Albufeira) and filters by date. Search interface details were not read directly: the site is a JavaScript app and no terms page URL was seen; gap.
